news.headline: Delcath Systems (NASDAQ:DCTH) Trading 9.3% Higher – Still a Buy?
news.summary: Delcath shares rose as much as 9.3% intraday to $16.51 on more than double average trading volume, extending the post-earnings rally that followed the August 6 Q2 2026 beat-and-raise report.

news.headline: Craig-Hallum Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $24, Maintains Buy Rating
news.summary: Craig-Hallum raised its price target on Delcath to $24 while reiterating a Buy rating, continuing the wave of upward analyst revisions following the company's Q2 2026 beat-and-raise report.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $31 from $29, Reiterates Buy Rating
news.summary: Following Delcath's Q2 2026 beat-and-raise report, H.C. Wainwright reiterated a Buy rating and lifted its price target to $31 from $29, citing continued HEPZATO commercial momentum.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million (up from $24.2 million a year earlier, including $27.1 million of HEPZATO KIT and $2.0 million of CHEMOSAT sales) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million, and ended the quarter with $95.9 million in cash and investments, no debt, and net income of $2.7 million.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $21 from $17, Maintains Buy Rating
news.summary: BTIG Research lifted its price target on Delcath to $21 from $17 while keeping a Buy rating after the company's Q2 2026 earnings beat, which included EPS of $0.07 versus a forecast loss of $0.09 and revenue of $29.1 million.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in its global DELUMA Phase 2 trial testing HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, across 20+ US/European sites.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results expected roughly three months after the August 6, 2026 Q2 report, based on prior reporting cadence; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: HEPZATO treatment center expansion
catalysts.detail: Company guidance points to roughly 37 active treatment centers by year-end 2026 (up from 31 as of Q2 2026, trimmed from an earlier target), with the 40-center mark now expected in Q1 2027; over 50 additional centers are in active discussions.

catalysts.label: DELUMA and mCRC trial site activation
catalysts.detail: Delcath is targeting activation of nearly all planned sites for its Phase 2 metastatic colorectal cancer trial (26 sites) and its Phase 2 DELUMA metastatic breast cancer trial (15 sites) by year-end 2026, with first patients already dosed in both studies.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 colorectal cancer trial data readouts
catalysts.detail: Randomized ~90-patient trial of HEPZATO plus trifluridine-tipiracil/bevacizumab vs. that regimen alone in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer; hepatic progression-free survival (primary endpoint) is expected to read out by the end of 2027, with overall survival (secondary endpoint) expected in 2028. Management has said it will provide more precise readout timing later in the year as enrollment progresses.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 trial enrollment (metastatic breast cancer)
catalysts.detail: Global randomized ~90-patient trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care vs. standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer; first patient dosed July 2026, with enrollment continuing across 20+ US/European sites.

pulse: Delcath delivered a clear beat-and-raise Q2 2026 (revenue $29.1M vs. $24.2M a year ago, EPS of $0.07 beating a forecast loss, guidance lifted to $104-108M, $95.9M cash with no debt), triggering a wave of analyst price-target increases from H.C. Wainwright ($31), Craig-Hallum ($24), and BTIG ($21), all reiterating Buy ratings, and sending shares up roughly 9% in the days following the report (trading near $16.50-$17.25 through August 10-11). The DELUMA Phase 2 breast-cancer trial began dosing patients in July, extending HEPZATO's reach beyond uveal melanoma, while the colorectal cancer Phase 2 trial's hepatic progression-free survival readout is now guided for end of 2027. The main watch item remains the pace of new treatment-center activations, trimmed to about 37 by year-end 2026 with the 40-center mark pushed into Q1 2027, but underlying revenue growth, gross margin expansion, and the pipeline trajectory remain intact.
